rule_text.name: 702.254a
rule_text.rule: Acquiesce appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two abilities. The first is a spell ability that functions while the spell with acquiesce is on the stack. The second is a triggered ability that functions while the card with acquiesce is in the exile zone. “Acquiesce” means “If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it” and “Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to an opponent, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 702.254b
rule_text.rule: An exiled card with acquiesce does not need to be cast at the first opportunity. If it is not, the ability will still trigger the next time combat damage is dealt.

rule_text.name: 702.259a
rule_text.rule: Simulacrum is a triggered ability. “Simulacrum” means “When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it from your graveyard. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this card, except it's colorless, it's 1/1, it has no mana cost, and it's a Crystal artifact in addition to its other types.”

rule_text.name: 702.259b
rule_text.rule: If a permanent with simulacrum is controlled by a player other than its owner when it dies, that player will be unable to exile it from their graveyard, and won't create the token copy.
